subject: SpectraLabs dedicated sizing — request for short-term hold and inventory check
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2028-11-04T09:12:00Z
Subject: SpectraLabs dedicated sizing — request for short-term hold and inventory check

Team,

I had a 30-min follow-up with SpectraLabs (Elena + David) this morning. They are late-stage (PO expected in ~3–4 weeks) and want dedicated capacity for a private deployment. High-level asks:

- Initial request: 48 x A100-like cards for a 12-node pool (we discussed alternatives).
- Target go-live: mid-December (they want a firm window to align procurement).
- SLOs: 95th perc latency < 200ms for 2k token prompts, steady 1.2k rps burst testing planned.

They asked if we can "softly hold" capacity for 3 weeks while legal/finance finish the contract. They understand we can't block indefinitely but want a brief reservation window to avoid losing the slot to another deal.

Can ops/portfolio confirm:
1) Do we have the inventory to cover 48 A100 equivalents in the US-west region for the requested window (Dec 10–Jan 10)?
2) If not, what are close substitutes (e.g., 80 x A10s equivalent)?
3) Recommend duration and mechanism for a soft hold (internal ticket, tagging capacity, or reserve pool).

Attaching the Spectra sizing PDF they sent (spectralabs_sizing_request.pdf). Ben/Karthik — can you run an availability snapshot and a brief notes doc with risks by EOD tomorrow? Vivek — if you can propose an approved soft-hold playbook we'll reference to Legal/RevOps.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Senior Director, Strategic Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-11-04T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: SpectraLabs dedicated sizing — request for short-term hold and inventory check

Thanks Priya — good summary. Quick thoughts:

- We should be conservative with a "soft hold" policy: recommend 21 days (configurable) and require a 20% non-refundable commitment credit for holds > 14 days. That protects inventory without forcing complexity for Legal.
- Mechanism: tag capacity in Dedicated Controller as "soft-hold:SL-2028-47" and set automated release timestamp. Ops must approve the tag.
- Substitutes: if A100 equivalents are tight, we can offer mixed pools: 24 A100 + 48 A10x for spillover with transparent perf projections. We must sync with ModelOps for quantization guidance.

Ben/Karthik — can you provide the inventory snapshot (region breakdown + available reserved vs idle) and the projected impact on SLAs if we reserve 48 cards? I'll draft the soft-hold template (including the 20% credit language) and share it with Legal.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-11-05T15:27:00Z
Subject: Re: SpectraLabs dedicated sizing — request for short-term hold and inventory check

Attaching inventory snapshot (gpu_inventory_snapshot_20281104.csv) and a quick note on options. Summary:

- US-west total free capacity right now: 56 A100-equivalents (after accounting for scheduled Dedicated rollouts through Nov 30).
- There is a planned maintenance window Nov 20–22 that may reduce visible capacity by ~8 A100-equivalents during that time but will be completed well before the requested Dec 10 start.
- Recommendation: we can provision 48 A100-equivalents for Dec 10–Jan 10, but I suggest a 14-day soft hold with a 20% commitment credit to be paid at hold start. This gives us a 2-week window to close contract; beyond 14 days we escalate to sales ops leadership for extension.

Risks/notes:
- If SpectraLabs requests a strict physical isolation guarantee (strict single-tenant without hypervisor consolidation), the usable pool drops to ~40 A100-equivalents; we'd need to negotiate either longer lead time or a hybrid solution.
- If they accept mixed pool topology (A100 + A10x), we can keep performance within 10–15% of target for many workloads but must run model validation during onboarding.

Proposed next steps:
1) Priya to confirm with SpectraLabs the willingness to put down the 20% credit and the desired isolation level.
2) Ops to apply soft-hold tag for 14 days once credit clears (or CFO confirmation).
3) Karthik to open a ModelOps task for perf validation if mixed topology is used.

Attachments: gpu_inventory_snapshot_20281104.csv

-Ben
Ben Carter
Capacity Planning Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@spectralabs.co>, David Li <david.li@spectralabs.co>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-11-07T16:03:00Z
Subject: RE: SpectraLabs dedicated sizing — request for short-term hold and inventory check

Hi Elena / David — thanks for the chat earlier this week. Quick update from our side:

- We can provision the requested capacity for your Dec 10 go-live window (48 A100-equivalents in US-west) subject to a short soft-hold.
- Redwood asks for a 14-day soft-hold with a 20% refundable credit applied at start of the hold. The soft-hold will tag and reserve the capacity; if the contract completes within 14 days we convert to contract-backed reservation and apply credit to first invoice. If not, the tag expires unless both sides approve an extension.

Options you can choose:
- Option A (preferred): 14-day soft-hold + 20% credit; isolation best-effort (shared infra, priority scheduling).
- Option B: stricter physical isolation (single-tenant), requires additional lead time and may reduce available capacity to ~40 A100-equivalents; will increase cost ~18%.
- Option C: mixed topology (24 A100 + A10x spillover) — cheaper and faster to provision, requires a short perf validation run during onboarding.

If you confirm Option A and agree to the initial 20% credit, we'll submit the internal soft-hold tag today and notify Legal/RevOps to start the PO/contract process. Attaching the proposed soft-hold instructions for review (soft_hold_instructions.docx).

Please reply with which option you prefer and whether you can clear the initial credit this week.

Best,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Senior Director, Strategic Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
